svg.aria-label: Pixels are encoded once into a small latent, the denoiser and solver loop on that latent N times, and the decoder runs once to produce the image
svg.text: ONE ENCODE · MANY DENOISE CALLS · ONE DECODE
EVERY ONE OF THE N CALLS RUNS HERE
Benefit · the ×64 element saving repeats at every one of the N denoiser calls
Ceiling · anything E drops out of those 262,144 positions is not in the 4,096, and D cannot invent it
